profile.title: Senior Freelance Frontend Engineer
profile.summary: Senior freelance frontend developer with 10+ years of experience building large-scale web applications and digital platforms for enterprise, public-sector, and agency clients. Specialised in React, Next.js, Vue, TypeScript, frontend architecture, accessibility, and performance optimisation.

freelance.availability: Available for freelance projects and long-term collaborations

projectSupplements.details: Freelance engagement via Scholz & Volkmer GmbH for Deutsche Bahn (March 2024 – February 2026). Software used by service staff to inform travelers about train connections, delays, and related updates. Christian implemented Vue-based components, performed bug-fixing, and integrated APIs. Also built with TypeScript across desktop, mobile, customer displays, and dedicated hardware terminals.

Freelance engagement via Scholz & Volkmer GmbH (June 2025 – September 2025). German Federal Ministry of Education and Research (BMBF) initiative focused on environment and sustainability. Developed a Vue/Nuxt web app combined with physical sensors as a toolkit for citizens without formal academic training. Christian led initial frontend setup and visualised sensor data from a Directus backend on maps using MapTiler and Leaflet.
React, TypeScript, and TanStack Query management platform for monitoring production equipment and scheduling maintenance in a large-scale dairy manufacturing environment.
Built scalable React frontend components and AEM templates for BMW's corporate platform.
Led frontend architecture on Liferay, delivering reusable portal components in close collaboration with design and backend teams.
Frontend lead for the mobile web launch experience. Led the swipeable mobile version of an HTML scrollpage with fullscreen imagery and device-independent usage.
Contributed to the official McDonald's Germany iOS application. The app reached more than 2 million downloads and ranked among the top 15 most downloaded iPhone apps in Germany in 2012.
Led frontend development for national campaigns including Do-Your-Own-Coupons, Mexify Yourself, Blend-in-Cup, and Big Mac Hunt.

webShop.title: Ecommerce Platform
webShop.summary: Designed and built a complete multi-tenant ecommerce platform for launching fully branded online stores, with product management, payments, multilingual support, SEO, shipping, content management, and a modern administration interface. Built with Payload CMS, Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Cloudflare R2, and Stripe, the platform combines a flexible storefront with a full ecommerce backend, multi-tenant architecture, and managed infrastructure. Offered as a managed SaaS subscription or lifetime licence, with custom development available for businesses that need functionality beyond the core platform. Product details, pricing, and live demo stores are on the marketing website (English at the root URL; Danish at /da; German at /de).

features.title: Branding & Domains
features.description: Flexible storefront branding with logos, colours, typography, theme controls, and custom domains on the Brand plan — designed to create distinctive storefronts rather than template-based experiences.

features.title: Product management
features.description: Products, variants, categories, pricing, and media in one administration interface, with draft workflows and live preview before publishing.

features.title: Storefront Experience
features.description: Carts, favourites, guest checkout, customer accounts, order history, secure order lookup, and discount codes provide a complete shopping experience out of the box.

features.title: Payments & Payouts
features.description: Stripe Connect Express gives merchants their own connected Stripe account, with secure checkout, payment handling, payouts, and transactional order emails.

features.title: Content and SEO
features.description: A flexible layout builder supports landing pages and content sections such as heroes, grids, carousels, CTAs, and forms, alongside integrated SEO controls — without relying on a separate page-builder app.

features.title: Shipping and languages
features.description: Configurable shipping zones, optional Sendcloud integration for live rates, and multilingual storefronts in English, Danish, German, and Spanish with translation workflows in the administration interface.

features.title: VAT & Tax Settings
features.description: Store-level VAT and tax configuration supports country-specific rates, with gross catalog and shipping prices and VAT clearly presented during checkout.

technology.intro: Designed and engineered with proven technologies chosen for performance, maintainability, scalability, and a strong developer experience.
technology.closing: A production-ready architecture spanning multi-tenant ecommerce, content management, payments, media storage, internationalisation, integrations, and deployment infrastructure.

plansAndPricing.summary: Managed SaaS or Lifetime Licence. Choose a fully managed subscription for a hands-off platform experience, or a lifetime licence for businesses that want to own their store and source. The platform provides a substantial ecommerce foundation without requiring a collection of third-party apps for core functionality; custom features and integrations can be developed as a separate service. Also available: migrations, custom ecommerce development, agency licensing, and Concierge onboarding. All prices shown are net; German customers are typically charged an additional 19% VAT where applicable.
